feature_notes: Integrates live mutable merged declarations, atomic bulk replacement and sparse structural edits with named styles, themes, dimensions/grouping, rich values and hyperlink ownership. Stable merged handles and detached aliases retain their observed semantics; write-only close freezes worksheet metadata and preserves relationship identities. Native 262 tests/doctests, Rust 1.88 cross-platform CI and Python 575 tests pass (two Windows platform skips). Measured owned, loaded and write-only workloads are faster and use lower peak working sets than openpyxl at both measured sizes; write-only temporary disk use remains higher at 2000 records. Full M4-M7 and deferred feature graphs remain open.
